errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: OrderItemNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order item is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is set to a value that is not one of pending, confirmed, shipped, or cancelled.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when an order attempts to reserve stock that is not available in the product's current quantity.

errors.name: InvalidProductIdError
errors.description: Raised when a product ID is provided that is not valid (e.g., not a positive integer or not matching a known product).

errors.name: InvalidCustomerIdError
errors.description: Raised when a customer ID is provided that is not valid (e.g., not a positive integer or not matching a known customer).

errors.name: InvalidCategoryIdError
errors.description: Raised when a category ID is provided that is not valid (e.g., not a positive integer or not matching a known category).

errors.name: OrderCannotBeCancelledError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to cancel an order that is not in the confirmed state.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeConfirmedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to confirm an order that is already confirmed, shipped, or cancelled.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeShippedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to ship an order that is not in the confirmed state.

errors.name: FileNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when the SQLite database file cannot be found or accessed.

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when a CSV file contains malformed data that cannot be parsed into valid records.
